prompt: Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa circuit for the same balanced oracle as the standard dj_balanced_6q task (f(x) = x1 XOR x2 XOR x4 of a 5-bit input), but using a REVERSED qubit-ordering convention: here the ANCILLA is qubit 0 (not qubit 5), and the input register is qubits 1-5 (not 0-4), with input qubit i of the standard task now at qubit (5-i). Concretely, restate the oracle in this new ordering: input original-qubit-1 is now qubit 4, original-qubit-2 is now qubit 3, and original-qubit-4 is now qubit 1. Steps: initialize qubit 0 (ancilla) to |1> with an X gate, apply Hadamard to all 6 qubits, apply the oracle as CNOT(control=qubit 4, target=qubit 0), CNOT(control=qubit 3, target=qubit 0), and CNOT(control=qubit 1, target=qubit 0), then apply Hadamard to qubits 1-5 only (not the ancilla). Return the resulting 6-qubit state; no measurement.
